summary: @ubedsockets/baileys resolves a dependency from an unpinned GitHub repo and ships a hardcoded IP lockout
details: The package manifest declares `libsignal` as `github:rexxzyid/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA or tag. `npm install @ubedsockets/baileys` resolves the default branch of that third-party GitHub repository at install time and runs any lifecycle scripts contained in it, with no registry-side version or integrity pin. Whoever controls the `rexxzyid` account controls code that executes on every installer's machine. The manifest also declares `@ubedsockets/baileys@^1.7.9` as one of its own dependencies, producing a self-recursive install graph. Separately, `lib/Socket/socket.js` contains an inserted block that, on socket creation via the advertised `makeWASocket` API, fetches the host's public IP from ipify/ipinfo/checkip.amazonaws.com and calls `process.exit(1)` unless the detected IP matches one of two hardcoded addresses (20.207.192.84, 173.212.202.60), terminating the Node process of any consumer not running from those two IPs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
